data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to edit the Title, Description, Priority and Due Date of an existing task","so_that":"I can keep my task information current","business_description":"Users can update an existing task through the task form in edit mode. Editing covers Title, Description, Priority and Due Date, with the same validation as task creation. The backend validates the update and the frontend reports the confirmed result.","business_value":"Keeps task data accurate without deleting and recreating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the stores the new title and returns success"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend
